detections.evidence_quote: Some people said closing schools for so long was pointless and would cause much worse collateral damage to kids, and they were right.
detections.summary: A played Bill Maher clip argues officials should admit COVID-era mistakes, citing prolonged school closures as needless harm to kids.

detections.evidence_quote: everyone, including the Biden administration, admits there's at least a 50-50 chance that the virus could have begun in the lab in Wuhan that was doing gain-of-function research
detections.summary: The clip recalls a Daily Beast headline mocking the Wuhan lab-leak theory and says officials now say a lab origin is plausible.

detections.evidence_quote: when COVID hit, we did a lot of stupid things because America never reacts; it only overreacts
detections.summary: A host says COVID prompted many overreactions in America and that few retractions have followed.

detections.evidence_quote: all these guys were all pushing the same thing with the with the vaccine and with all the COVID stuff
detections.summary: Speakers accuse commentators of having pushed uniform pro-vaccine/COVID messaging and demand accountability, listing alleged harms including lockdowns, injuries, and rising cancer.

detections.evidence_quote: Were you guys getting paid to say it?
detections.summary: Speaker implies media commentators were paid to promote pro-vaccine/COVID messaging.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Closing schools for a long period during the COVID-19 pandemic was pointless and caused much worse collateral damage to children.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: closing schools for so long was pointless and would cause much worse collateral damage to kids, and they were right
verification_candidates.rationale: Whether extended school closures caused more harm than benefit to children is empirically testable and central to assessing pandemic policy.

verification_candidates.claim_text: There is at least a 50-50 chance that the COVID-19 virus began in a Wuhan lab that was doing gain-of-function research, according to the Biden administration.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: everyone, including the Biden administration, admits there's at least a 50-50 chance that the virus could have begun in the lab in Wuhan that was doing gain-of-function research on that virus
verification_candidates.rationale: The probability of a lab origin for COVID-19 is a contested, checkable claim about the pandemic's origin.
Whether cancer incidence has actually risen is a checkable statistic being used as evidence of harm from pandemic-era measures.
